faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Arabic.

items.q: Does it handle Arabic script correctly?
items.a: Yes, translations are shown in proper right-to-left Arabic script, not romanized letters.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Arabic into English?
items.a: Yes — speak Arabic into the mic and you'll get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Which form of Arabic does it use?
items.a: Translations use standard, widely understood Arabic, suited for everyday conversations, messages, and travel.

items.q: Can I hear how the Arabic translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need to install an app or keyboard?
items.a: No, it runs in your browser and displays Arabic script automatically — no special keyboard needed.
